tldr: Mars in the 2nd house: drive becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Mars in the 2nd house, this part of you pushes through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Mars describes drive, anger, courage, desire, defense, and the will to act. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Mars can become courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear.
gift: courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
